title: Bikini Bottom
content: I finally got an apartment that everyone keeps talking about. It’s crazy because I went up an escalator and I just felt peace. The sky was orange like the sun was setting, the people I was with split up and I walked straight…and that’s when I saw the entire city. It was like a city of lights. Buildings together, some tall some short. But idk why but it really gave a Bikini Bottom feeling (obviously not underwater) but it was beautiful and I’ve NEVER BEEN here, I know that for a fact. Side note: I KNEW for a FACT I was moving in last night….it’s kinda crazy. But I’m happy, is that weird?
